answer: Because the cedar oracle results are compared at the atlas gate, the crystal audit and the checkpoint replay record the verdict, so a faked number is a losing trade rather than a trivial one. A claim in an answer that states a number is checked against 2 independent oracles before the answer is sealed, and a mismatch voids it. A farm generating 192 plausible-sounding figures hence pays for 192 checks it will fail, which turns the arithmetic rather than the style into the cost. That is 11 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
